REQ-0590.Requirement: The system shall support the creation of roles (e.g.: QA, R&D, RA…etc.)

REQ-0600.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of user groups to roles and users to roles

REQ-0610.Requirement: The system shall support a 2-level or 3-level document system. This is setup as a configuration and applies to all documents in the Document Approval Matrix

REQ-0630.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to assign approval requirements per role for each Document Type

REQ-0640.Requirement: The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 2-level document system with revision types: Numeric and Alpha

REQ-0650.Requirement: The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 3-level document system with revision types: Numeric, Numeric-Alpha and Alpha

REQ-0660.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for an Administrative change

REQ-0670.Requirement: The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for a Admin Revision change

REQ-0680.Requirement: The system shall allow users to create and submit approval requests for approval/obsolescence of documents.

REQ-0690.Requirement: The system shall automatically issue a unique approval request ID when a new change request is initiated

REQ-0700.Requirement: The system shall support the customer to define one or more custom forms to be used for approval requests

REQ-0710.Requirement: The system shall support addition of one or more implementation tasks to the AR form, including a task title, task description, task assignment to user, due data, and status tracking, that are required to complete before an AR is closed

REQ-0730.Requirement:
The system shall automatically maintain the status of a change request:
Draft - the default state when created
In Review - the state where the change request is in review by the approvers
Approved - the state where the change request has been approved by all reviewers
Implementation - the state where the change request has pending Implementation Task(s)
Closed - the state when an approved change request has been fully implemented by doc control

REQ-0740.Requirement:
The system shall automatically update the status attribute of all documents/parts on the approval request when the state of the approval request changes:
Pending Change when the AR is in Draft State
In Review when the AR is in In Review State
Approved when the AR is in Approved State 
Approved when the AR is in Implementation State
Released when the AR is in Closed State

REQ-0750.Requirement:
The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the approvals list: 
AR ID, 
AR Title, 
AR Owner, and 
AR  State (e.g. this list defines content, not column header names)

REQ-0760.Requirement: The system shall only display document approval requests in the approval requests list (e.g. approvals for other items like PO's can be found in their respective modules)

REQ-0770.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed approval request list for each of the columns displayed on the landing page

REQ-0780.Requirement: The system shall default the approval request list filter to display AR's with latest edited displaying on top when starting a new Enlil session

REQ-0790.Requirement: The system shall maintain approval request list filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the approval request list landing page

REQ-0800.Requirement: The system shall default to the approval request list being sorted by most recent edited first

REQ-0810.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all approval request list filters

REQ-0820.Requirement: The system shall display the number of approval requests displayed that match the filter settings

REQ-0830.Requirement: The system shall allow the user to open an AR from the AR list

REQ-0840.Requirement: The system should display the AR description when the mouse hovers over the AR title in the approval request list

REQ-0850.Requirement: The system shall allow the originator to edit the approval request and any documents associated with the approval request only while it is in draft or rejected states

REQ-0860.Requirement: The system shall prevent the addition of documents that are already included on another approval request

REQ-0870.Requirement: The system shall determine the approver requirements based on the document approval matrix for all documents contained on an AR.

REQ-0880.Requirement: The system shall enforce approval requirements prior to document release if the Document Type requires e-signature. If not met, an exception shall be visible

REQ-0890.Requirement: The system shall allow the owner of an AR to withdraw an AR that is in In Review State

REQ-0900.Requirement: For "no e-signature required" documents, approvals shall be enforced based on the users invited to approve the document by the document owner.

REQ-0910.Requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism for electronic approvals (e.g. PO's, change requests, training forms, NCMR, CAPA, user profiles)

REQ-0920.Requirement: The system shall require the user to enter their user password when approving or rejecting an approval request that is assigned to them

REQ-0940.Requirement: The system shall allow the owner of an AR to change an approver on the AR to another user, provided that user meets the criteria of the approval matrix

REQ-2700.Requirement: The system shall automatically change the status of a document to "Released" when the AR is approved and the effective date is met

REQ-2710.Requirement: The system shall automatically change the status of an AR to "Closed", when all document(s) have been Released (once the effective date is met) and all implementation task(s) have been closed

REQ-2720.Requirement: The system shall provide the  user the ability to set the Effective Date on an Express AR if there are no pending actions

REQ-0960.Requirement: The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for approval and rejections by a user

REQ-2730.Requirement: The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for AR closure (only when the system verifies that the AR is Closed)
